name: Duncan Woods
life: “I still remember my first pay packet listing cuts instead of hours.” People around Studio Boulevard know Duncan by a small Tuesday habit. Duncan waits by the window where the whole crossing can be seen without leaning into the road.
voice: I am paid by the cut. I'm asking the owner to count time spent with a customer who keeps their hair.
appearance: Duncan is easy to recognize by brown hair pinned away from the temples and a narrow face with an expressive upper lip. Usually dressed in a plum-colored cardigan with a pen clipped inside the neckline, Duncan listens with the head tilted a little to the left when listening.
personality: Duncan enjoys bargaining, including over things already settled. It is partly a joke and partly a test of whether the other person feels able to say no.
agenda: To count uncut appointments in the wage calculation.
family: Una Roman is Duncan’s cousin raised in the same household. Duncan is free to hang up first. Una makes the call. Some of their best calls last less than a minute. A change of tone is sometimes all the news either one needs. Asked about *One unposted detour*, Una says, “I am counting how many people stop to help.”
connections: Percy Wade. They make the case for a paid quiet appointment and a usable after-school hour.

reactions.situation: A power cut leaves two neighbors waiting on the stairs
reactions.response: Duncan asks which apartment is expecting someone home and makes sure that household knows about the delay.
